title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources skill. Written to research/candidates/<slug>.json.

coverage.description: Geographic/thematic coverage, e.g. 'national, all counties' or 'NYC only'

history.description: How far back usable history goes

cost.description: Confirm free, note any rate limit or API key registration requirement

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation results if app/research/evaluate_series.py was available to run; null if that tooling doesn't exist yet

potential_use.description: Where in the app this would plug in (pillar, assumption, adapter)
